5. Debt on top: $570B of AI bonds forecast this year

Etched is considering investor proposals that could value the four-year-old AI chip and systems company at $40–50 billion, according to people familiar with the talks. No investment has been agreed, discussions are at an early stage, and the terms could change. The company was valued at $21 billion in September, when it raised $700 million.

The proposals reflect investor interest in Etched’s effort to compete with Nvidia. Etched says its chips can process more text for AI systems, faster and at lower cost than Nvidia’s; that remains the company’s claim, not an independently confirmed result. Etched declined to comment on the discussions.
